cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CCA2119, you are maintaining 4,500 meters over VYK, you have received information X, make an initial contact with Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航2119，你现在正保持在4500米，过VYK，你已经收到通播X，与北京进近进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, maintaining 4500m, over VYK, information X.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，正保持4500米，过VYK， 通播X。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descent to 3,000m, QNH 1011, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，北京进近，雷达看见了，下3000米，修压1011，预计盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Descent to 3,000m, QNH 1011, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下3000米，修压1011，预计盲降进近跑道36右，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, ask Beijing Approach to turn left to circumnavigate the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，询问北京进近，左转绕飞天气。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, request turn left to avoid the weather ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，请求左转避开天气。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, negative due prohibited area. Turn right heading 030.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，由于禁飞区，不可以，右转航向030。

cards.audioText: N: [During maneuver, your left windshield has cracked, report it to Beijing Approach and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在机动过程中，你的左侧风挡破裂，报告给北京进近，请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, request descent due left windshield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，由于风挡破裂，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, turn right heading 330, descend to and maintain 1,800 meters, when able, advise your situation on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，右转航向330，下到1800米保持，可以的时候，报告机上情况。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to and maintain 1,800 meters, wilco, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向330，下到1800米保持，照办，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [A few minutes later, tell the controller that the aircraft is still controlled and there are no injuries on board.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后，告知管制员，飞机仍旧可以控制，机上没有人受伤。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, aircraft is under control, and no one injured on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，飞机现在可以控制，机上没有人受伤。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, continue present heading, descent to 1,200 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，保持当前航向，下1200米保持，可以盲降进近。跑道36右，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue present heading, descent to 1,200 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, wilco, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下1200米保持，可以盲降进近，跑道36右，照办，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you have established on the localizer runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经建立跑道36右的航向道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, established on the localizer runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，建立跑道36右的盲降。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, radar service terminated, you are 10 miles from touchdown, contact Beijing Tower 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，雷达服务终止，你现在距离接地点10海里，联系北京塔台118.5。

cards.audioText: N: [Now You are 10 miles from touchdown, Contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在距离接地点10海里，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA2119, 10 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航2119，距离接地点10海里。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots, runway 36R, clear to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，地面风350度，5节，跑道36右，可以落地。

cards.audioText: N: [After landing, you can’t find the taxiway clearly, ask Beijing Ground for a tug to tow you to the apron.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【落地之后，你不发清晰找到滑行道，请求北京地面安排一辆拖车将你拖回机坪。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA2119, request a tug to tow back to the apron due windshield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航2119，由于风挡破裂，请求一辆拖车将我们拖回机坪。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, hold position, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，原地等待，拖车正在路上。
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，收到，谢谢，国航2119。
